records.title: Monthly Internship — Insolvency, Liquidation & Bankruptcy
records.duration: Normally 1 month; extension up to 1 additional month at IBBI discretion
records.eligibility: Students pursuing a 3- or 5-year law degree, or postgraduate/MPhil/PhD study in Economics, Commerce, Finance, Management or Law. Institutional recommendation is mandatory. A general undergraduate commerce degree alone does not qualify.
records.description: Support an IBBI division on insolvency, liquidation and bankruptcy work and complete a supervised dissertation or report. Bring your own laptop.
records.applicationSteps: Use the annexed form in the official guidelines, obtain the institution’s recommendation, and email it to intern@ibbi.gov.in at least 30 days before the proposed start. For a January placement, apply by 30 November following the guideline’s example. Include the requested motivation and dissertation proposal.
records.evidence: The official 2023 guidelines were downloaded and read on 9 November 2026. They establish recurring monthly applications, the email/form, eligibility and stipend; IBBI’s 2024–25 annual report also records the scheme in use.
records.caveat: A standing application scheme newly added to this refresh, not a newly announced 2026 vacancy. Monthly intake depends on IBBI requirements and selection; submitting an application does not guarantee a place.
